To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the activities of membrane marker enzymes were elevated in the oncogene-transformed cells compared to the normal 3T3 control cells, suggesting that membrane synthesis and/or turnover was enhanced.

5′- nucleotidase and UDPase activities in the oncogenic viruses-transformed cells were significantly higher than those of the 3T 3 cells, and that esterase activity was slightly elevated in oncogenic virus-transform cells.

5′- nucleotidase, an enzyme that is normally associated with the plasma membrane, and esterase, an enzyme that has been associated with rough endoplasmical reticulum, are significantly elevated in the RNA and DNA virus transformed cell lines.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of RNA and DNA oncogenic viruses on the membrane marker enzyme activity of fibroblasts in tissue culture.
the effects of oncogenic transformation on membrane marker enzymes in cultured cells.
the study of the effects of viral infection and transformation on cell membranes and the possible relationship between membrane changes and viral oncogenesis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the oncogenic virus transformation of the 3T 3 cells results in a significant increase in the plasma membrane marker enzyme activity, 5′- nucleotidase, and a slight increase in the smooth endoplasmie reticulum marker, UDPase.
the plasma membrane of the transformed cells is larger than that of the untransformed 3T3 cell.
the membrane markers studied were elevated in oncogenic virus-transforming cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the membrane marker enzyme activities are elevated in the transformed cells compared to 3T3.
the oncogenic virus-induced alterations in the membrane enzyme activities are similar to those induced by SV40 virus.
the oncogenic virus transformed cell lines have a higher plasma membrane and rough endoplasm membrane surface area and/or more enzyme per unit surface area than the 3T 3 cells.
